requested_outcome: Turn every relevant VII search results page into a deep discovery page with separate contextual rails for regions, cities, place types and smart searches, plus truthful nearby trails and matching providers.
natural_destination: VII vacation and event search results, with the shared below-results component remaining valid for spa, hourly, providers and attractions.
authorization_boundary: Implementation, tests, commit, push and the already-requested combined production publication are authorized. No new supplier facts, purchases or destructive data changes are allowed.

lesson_bundle.reason: The complaint is about a feature family that disappeared from search pages, not one isolated card.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every depth layer and the affected search-world family must be mapped to visible evidence before completion.

lesson_bundle.reason: Every rail exposes navigation arrows and clickable cards.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Enabled and disabled arrow states, keyboard semantics and every destination must agree with actual behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: Search discovery rails are heavily used on mobile.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The complete stack must remain readable, swipeable and free of overflow at 390 pixels and through breakpoint transitions.

lesson_bundle.reason: The new headings and dynamic Hebrew labels are prominent public interface text.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Heebo and approved sans-serif fallbacks must cover every added heading, card and state from first paint.

lesson_bundle.reason: These links form the internal-link graph for indexable search landing pages.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Links must preserve valid search intent without silently creating indexable thin combinations or contradictory canonical signals.

lesson_bundle.reason: Dynamic labels must read naturally in Hebrew and remain meaningful in all supported languages.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Location-aware labels must be localized, non-repetitive and must not claim exact distance or supplier suitability without evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The approved results, reviews, guide and FAQ must remain intact while depth navigation is expanded.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The change preserves existing results, filters, URL state, guide, reviews and FAQ behavior.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The page still shows two generic rows instead of the full hierarchy Adir listed.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Model regions, cities, place types, smart searches and additional regions as separate named rails.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A center-vacation search visibly renders each applicable rail with distinct content and titles.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Cards say only ‘villas’ or ‘with pool’ and lose the selected place name.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Generate location-scoped labels for every type and smart-search card.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The center example includes labels such as ‘וילות במרכז’ and ‘נופש במרכז עם בריכה’.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Trails or providers are shown as nearby even though the data does not prove relevance.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use existing area tags and verified provider service coverage, with honest ‘באזור’ wording and omit unmatched rows.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every shown trail matches an area tag and every provider is nationwide or explicitly covers the selected area.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The feature works for vacation but breaks events or another shared world.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep the shared component API compatible and test vacation, events and all existing world callers.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Focused contract tests and production build cover all six shared worlds.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The rails are attractive but arrows lie about whether scrolling is possible.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reuse the site-wide boundary-aware slider control and preserve native horizontal swipe.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: At both boundaries only the possible direction is enabled and the disabled direction is visibly and semantically disabled.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The added depth makes the page slow or unwieldy on mobile.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use compact lazy-loaded visual cards, bounded item counts and no new network request in the interaction path.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The candidate loads the rails without a new fetch, images remain lazy and the 390-pixel layout has no horizontal page overflow.

contextual type and smart-search URL generation

sources.label: Accepted screenshot of the current VII below-results discovery panel
Legacy VII focused-search and relevant-category behavior
VII product truth and search standards

midpoint_gate.trigger: The center-vacation example renders from real catalog data with four separated contextual rails.
checks: Compare the visible hierarchy against the user's screenshot and requested inventory.
Open one city, type and smart-search card and verify the preserved search state.
Confirm the component omits irrelevant or empty rails before adding trails and providers.

attack_questions: Does a city search accidentally label unrelated cities as nearby or collapse regions and cities into one row?
Does any contextual link lose dates, guests or active filters that should be preserved?
Can a trail or provider appear without a data-backed relation to the selected area?
Can either slider arrow still be pressed when no movement is possible?
Does the added stack overflow, clip or become unreadable on a 390-pixel viewport?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact deployed vacation and event search URLs showing the new depth stack, with opened destinations and desktop/mobile screenshots.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests, production build, static font audit and live checks across all shared SearchAfterResults callers.

effectiveness.baseline: The current shared component exposes only one mixed destination rail and one mixed related-search rail, while trails and providers are absent.
effectiveness.target: All requested depth layers appear in one release with zero generic labels that omit the selected location and no unsupported nearby claim.
